reply.subject: Your landlord’s reported phone call about ending the lease

clauses.text: You report that the property manager said by phone that the landlord was ending the lease at the end of March, and that you have not received any written termination notice.
You also say that the flat is your family home and that both you and your wife live there and are registered at the address.

The information currently available does not establish the date of the call, which year was meant by “the end of March”, or whether written notice has since arrived; on that information, we cannot determine a notice or challenge deadline or give a concluded view on the call’s legal effect.

Please tell us the calendar date of the call and the year meant by “the end of March”. Please also confirm whether any written termination notice or official form has arrived since the call, including anything addressed to Lena; if so, tell us when and by whom it was received and the termination date stated, and send us a copy and any envelope or delivery evidence.
Please also send us a copy of your lease contract, so the agreed notice period and termination dates can be checked.
